allHead:
<style>
/* ===== MMuzhou Blog 全站美化样式 =====
   生效通道：config.json -> allHead 字段
   所有页面（首页/文章页/标签页）统一生效 */

/* 1. 全局基础 */
body{
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif !important;
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(250,251,255,.62), rgba(240,242,252,.68)), url('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MMuzhou-0/StudyBlog/main/background.jpg') center/cover no-repeat fixed !important;
  min-height: 100vh !important;
  max-width: 980px !important;
  padding: 30px 40px !important;
  color: #1f2430 !important;
  transition: background .3s ease;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] body{
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(9,11,24,.70), rgba(12,15,30,.76)), url('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MMuzhou-0/StudyBlog/main/background.jpg') center/cover no-repeat fixed !important;
  color: #d8dbea !important;
}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  body{ padding: 14px !important; }
}
::selection{ background: rgba(108,92,231,.28); }
::-webkit-scrollbar{ width: 10px; height: 10px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{ background: rgba(108,92,231,.4); border-radius: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{ background: rgba(108,92,231,.6); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{ background: transparent; }

/* 2. 链接 */
body a{ color: #6c5ce7 !important; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s ease; }
body a:hover{ color: #4f40c9 !important; text-decoration: underline; }
html[data-color-mode='dark'] body a{ color: #a29bfe !important; }
html[data-color-mode='dark'] body a:hover{ color: #c8c0ff !important; }

/* 3. 头部毛玻璃卡片 */
#header{
  margin-top: 36px !important;
  padding: 22px 28px !important;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.75) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(108,92,231,.1) !important;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] #header{
  background: rgba(24,27,56,.72) !important;
  border-color: rgba(120,120,210,.16) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.4) !important;
}

/* 4. 头像 */
#header img.avatar{
  border: 3px solid #fff !important;
  outline: 2px solid #6c5ce7;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(108,92,231,.22), 0 8px 20px rgba(108,92,231,.28) !important;
  transition: transform .45s ease, box-shadow .45s ease !important;
}
#header img.avatar:hover{
  transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1.06);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(108,92,231,.32), 0 10px 26px rgba(108,92,231,.36) !important;
}

/* 5. 博客标题渐变流光 */
#header .blogTitle{
  font-size: 38px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-family: inherit !important;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #6c5ce7, #a29bfe, #6c5ce7);
  background-size: 200% auto;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  animation: titleFlow 6s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes titleFlow{ to{ background-position: 200% center; } }

/* 6. 列表卡片化 */
.SideNav.border{ border: none !important; }
.SideNav-item{
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.72) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  padding: 16px 20px !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(108,92,231,.07) !important;
  transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease !important;
}
.SideNav-item:hover{
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.95) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(108,92,231,.16) !important;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] .SideNav-item{
  background: rgba(26,29,58,.7) !important;
  border-color: rgba(120,120,210,.14) !important;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] .SideNav-item:hover{
  background: rgba(34,38,74,.85) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.45) !important;
}
.listTitle{ font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.SideNav-icon{ color: #6c5ce7; }
html[data-color-mode='dark'] .SideNav-icon{ color: #a29bfe; }

/* 7. 标签胶囊 */
.Label{
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 3px 12px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
}

/* 8. 分页 */
.paginate-container{ margin-top: 28px !important; }
.pagination .previous_page, .pagination .next_page{
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  padding: 6px 16px !important;
}

/* 9. 页脚 */
#footer{ margin-top: 72px !important; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(108,92,231,.12); }
#footer1, #footer2, #footer a{ color: #6b7280 !important; }
html[data-color-mode='dark'] #footer1, html[data-color-mode='dark'] #footer2{ color: #8b8fa8 !important; }

/* 10. 标签页元素 */
span.tagTitle{
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #6c5ce7, #a29bfe);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
.title-right .subnav-search{
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(108,92,231,.2);
}
.subnav-search .subnav-search-input{
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.8) !important;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] .subnav-search .subnav-search-input{
  background: rgba(26,29,58,.7) !important;
  color: #d8dbea !important;
}
#taglabel .Label{ margin-bottom: 6px !important; }
.Counter{ border-radius: 999px !important; }

/* 11. 文章正文排版 */
.markdown-body{
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.85 !important;
}
.markdown-body h1, .markdown-body h2, .markdown-body h3, .markdown-body h4{
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  margin-top: 1.6em !important;
  margin-bottom: .6em !important;
}
.markdown-body h1{ font-size: 1.7em !important; }
.markdown-body h2{ font-size: 1.45em !important; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(108,92,231,.15) !important; padding-bottom: .3em !important; }
.markdown-body h3{ font-size: 1.25em !important; }
.markdown-body p{ margin: .8em 0 !important; }
.markdown-body a{ color: #6c5ce7 !important; text-decoration: underline !important; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.markdown-body code{
  background: rgba(108,92,231,.1) !important;
  color: #5b4bc4 !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  padding: 2px 6px !important;
  font-size: .9em !important;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] .markdown-body code{
  background: rgba(162,155,254,.14) !important;
  color: #b9b1ff !important;
}
.markdown-body pre{
  background: #1e2130 !important;
  color: #e6e6f0 !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 16px 18px !important;
  overflow-x: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18) !important;
}
.markdown-body pre code{ background: transparent !important; color: inherit !important; padding: 0 !important; }
.markdown-body blockquote{
  border-left: 4px solid #6c5ce7 !important;
  background: rgba(108,92,231,.07) !important;
  border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0 !important;
  padding: 10px 16px !important;
  color: #4a4f6a !important;
  margin: 1em 0 !important;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] .markdown-body blockquote{
  background: rgba(108,92,231,.12) !important;
  color: #c6c9dd !important;
}
.markdown-body img{ max-width: 100% !important; border-radius: 12px !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.12) !important; }
.markdown-body table{ border-collapse: collapse !important; width: 100% !important; margin: 1em 0 !important; display: table !important; }
.markdown-body th, .markdown-body td{ border: 1px solid rgba(108,92,231,.2) !important; padding: 8px 12px !important; }
.markdown-body th{ background: rgba(108,92,231,.08) !important; font-weight: 600 !important; }
.markdown-body hr{ border: none !important; height: 1px !important; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(108,92,231,.4), transparent) !important; margin: 2em 0 !important; }
.markdown-body ul, .markdown-body ol{ padding-left: 1.6em !important; }
.markdown-body li{ margin: .35em 0 !important; }

/* 12. 文章页标题 */
h1.postTitle{
  font-size: 34px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #3a2f8f, #6c5ce7);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
html[data-color-mode='dark'] h1.postTitle{
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #a29bfe, #d0caff);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
</style>
